rulings.ruling: OPERATOR_CHOICE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_PK-7; ONLY_ABI_AND_SCOPE_PRESERVING_ROUTE_ADMISSIBLE. Reservation concerns a concrete material component transport/library architecture choice, not editing pinned implementation files or recomputing effective pins.
rulings.owner: operator for material architecture; lead prepares concrete artifacts
rulings.evidence_required: Both original Decide exports and profiles/layouts, every original interface unit, SPARK_Mode-only mirror correspondence, native positive/refusal controls, complete source/project/link/header/library identity, retained native body obligations and the actual operator decision.

rulings.ruling: REPROVISION_UNDER_OPERATOR_CUSTODY_AT_DEPLOYMENT; mismatch refusal remains. An old-library hold supplies no consolidated-candidate acceptance.
rulings.evidence_required: Installed/loaded matching reviewed library, protected native_sha256, operator-controlled provisioning record and mismatch refusal evidence.

rulings.ruling: LEAD_OWNED_STRICT_OBLIGATION; confirming representation repairs preserve C1-C8 and satisfy E1-E6. Any nonconfirming material ABI change is separately operator-owned and grants no weakening of the original target.
rulings.owner: lead; operator only for material ABI change
rulings.evidence_required: Exact representation output, installed legality, strict warning/proof evidence, matching baseline layout identity, independent ABI and actual GPT-6.1 different-author delta review.

boundary: The current user's supervision rule is controlling. A design brief, prior review, pinning alone or this review supplies no new approval authority. No operator choice, deployment action or acceptance is granted.
